newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.01 up in the kerb market at 40.27 to the dollar on Thursday in dull trade, dealers said.
They said dollar demand balanced supply and the market was likely to open stable on Saturday after the Friday weekend.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on September 10, was 36.9700/37.1549 to the dollar.
The premium on the foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 8.70 percent. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
